text:
deploybot: Deploy gate triggered automatically: incident detected in kvcache (eu-west-1). Canary halted, no 100% promotion. Runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/kvcache-incident :rotating_light:

anna: On it — which release ID? Need to update PMs and release notes ASAP.

deploybot: Release ID r-2026-03-20-457. Image registry.redwood/inference:2.3.7. Canary group: canary-3-5. Traffic at 10%, not progressed.

mike: I pulled logs — spike in kv cache misses right after canary started. New kernel flag for eviction looks suspicious. Reverting that flag in staging helped.

jess: Oncall already started a canary rollback test to previous variant, results look promising. My suggestion: pin canary back to v2.3.6 and pause the rest of the rollout until infra patch. Ops, can you approve a swap?

ops_lead: Approve the swap back to v2.3.6. No hosts reached 100% so full rollback not required. Also propose deferring main rollout to allow CI + infra patch.

anna: Proposed new change window: 2026-03-21 02:00-04:00 UTC to give teams time to patch and run extended QA. I'll notify PMs and update release notes if we swap now.

mike: Command I'll run to perform canary swap:
```bash
deploybot swap-canary --release r-2026-03-20-457 --target-image registry.redwood/inference:2.3.6 --force
```

deploybot: Swap command queued, waiting for ops approval.

ops_lead: Approved — go ahead.

deploybot: Swap in progress...

deploybot: Swap complete. Canary now running image registry.redwood/inference:2.3.6. Observability: latency and error-rate back to baseline. Setting 30m elevated watch.

jess: We'll monitor for 30 minutes then report. If remains stable, recommend rescheduling full rollout to 2026-03-22 01:00-03:00 UTC to allow the kernel/eviction fix to merge and QA to sign off.

anna: I'll pin the release and add a note in the console. Draft to include: incident-induced rollback to v2.3.6; awaiting infra fix; new window proposed. Pin payload: 
```yaml
release:
  id: r-2026-03-20-457
  pin: v2.3.6
  reason: 'incident-induced rollback; awaiting infra kernel fix'
```

mike: Opening PR for kernel flag revert and linking here: https://github.com/redwood/inference/pull/3345 — will add test run results.

ops_lead: Documented in incident ticket INC-20260320-KVCACHE and updating the customer-facing status. Should we notify Dedicated customers? @customer-sweep if needed.

anna: I'll draft the customer note and add to release notes + status page. Thanks all — marking this thread for closure once the 30m watch completes and metrics look stable. :white_check_mark:

deploybot: Auto-note: canary swap completed and watch set. Thread will be auto-closed after successful watch period.
